description: 13.09 HIDDEN errata ('Change to First Bullet Point', wahapedia): INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM within a terrain area containing LIGHT or dense terrain features are hidden; the launch text (and this engine until now) said dense only. Live shooting path: Boyz Gamma ~17.6" from a Custodian Guard are a legal target in the open; a barricade (light) area under them makes them hidden, the target list drops them, and holding L with the shooter armed draws a red line labelled 'Hidden: only visible within 15" (closest ...)'. Controls: closing inside 15" restores the target; an exposed crater never hides.

steps.comment: The hot-seat handoff screen is a full-screen CanvasLayer that eats input; acknowledge it the way the player's [Enter] does before driving anything.

Setup: one Custodian Guard (24" Guardian spear) and Boyz Gamma (INFANTRY) ~19" apart (centres) at board x=12"; everything else removed from play. The board's own terrain is stashed and cleared for the run (restored in cleanup) so the injected area is the ONLY thing that can explain a refusal — with the fixture terrain in place a dense ruin beside the corridor triggers Gone to Ground (12"), which is correct but muddies the evidence. Shot stamps cleared so only terrain decides Hidden.
Frame both units so the on-board label is readable in the screenshots.
steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
main.view_zoom = 0.7
var vps = main.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
main.view_offset = Vector2(480, 1440) - vps / (2.0 * main.view_zoom)
main.update_view_transform()
return true
return RulesEngine.get_eligible_targets("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", GameState.create_snapshot(false)).has("U_BOYZ_K")
steps.comment: Control, no terrain: ~17.6" edge-to-edge is inside the spear's range and nothing hides the Boyz, so they ARE a legal target.

steps.script:
var xs = []
var ys = []
for m in GameState.get_unit("U_BOYZ_K")["models"]:
	if m.get("alive", true):
		xs.append(float(m["position"]["x"]))
		ys.append(float(m["position"]["y"]))
var pad = 60.0
var x0 = xs.min() - pad
var x1 = xs.max() + pad
var y0 = ys.min() - pad
var y1 = ys.max() + pad
TerrainManager.terrain_features.append({"id": "hid_light_area", "type": "barricade", "height_category": "low", "polygon": PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x0, y0), Vector2(x1, y0), Vector2(x1, y1), Vector2(x0, y1)])})
TerrainManager.emit_signal("terrain_loaded", TerrainManager.terrain_features)
return TerrainManager.category_of(TerrainManager.terrain_features.back())
steps.comment: Put a BARRICADE terrain area (LIGHT category, 13.04) under every Boyz model.
13.09 as amended by the errata: INFANTRY within a terrain area containing LIGHT terrain features are hidden. Before this fix only DENSE qualified, so this returned 'model ... NOT hidden'.
The rules engine refuses the Boyz for HIDDEN (not range, not LoS): beyond the 15" detection range, and the prose names light/dense terrain.

steps.script: return RulesEngine.get_eligible_targets("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", GameState.create_snapshot(false)).has("U_BOYZ_K")
steps.comment: ...so the target list really excludes them.
Guard the hard-coded row index below against fixture drift.
Real player input: select the Custodian Guard in the shooter list.

steps.script: main.get_node("ShootingController").active_shooter_id
main.t32_synthesize_l(true)
steps.comment: Hold L (the LoS overlay key) with the shooter armed: ineligible enemies get a reason line.
The Boyz line is RED (blocked) with reason code 'hidden' and a short on-board label leading with the 15" detection range (red lines were previously unlabelled, so the player could not tell why).

The per-model sight-line fan (drawn for every enemy when the shooter has no eligible targets) must not paint the hidden Boyz green: terrain alone is clear, but beyond detection range they are not visible. Before this fix every pair was drawn green next to the red 'Hidden' label.

steps.script: main.t32_synthesize_l(false)

steps.comment: Close to ~10" edge-to-edge: inside the 15" detection range a hidden unit is visible again.

steps.script: return RulesEngine.get_eligible_targets("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", GameState.create_snapshot(false)).has("U_BOYZ_K")

TerrainManager.terrain_features.back()["type"] = "crater"
TerrainManager.emit_signal("terrain_loaded", TerrainManager.terrain_features)
var u = GameState.get_unit("U_BOYZ_K")
return "%s|%s" % [TerrainManager.category_of(TerrainManager.terrain_features.back()), str(TerrainManager.is_model_hidden(u["models"][0], u))]
steps.comment: Control: an EXPOSED area (crater, 13.03) never hides.

steps.script: return RulesEngine.get_eligible_targets("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", GameState.create_snapshot(false)).has("U_BOYZ_K")

var saved = TerrainManager.get_meta("hid_saved_terrain", [])
TerrainManager.terrain_features = saved
TerrainManager.remove_meta("hid_saved_terrain")
TerrainManager.emit_signal("terrain_loaded", TerrainManager.terrain_features)
var lv = tree.root.get_node("Main/BoardRoot/LoSDebugVisual")
lv.hide_overview()
return "%d|%d" % [lv.overview_lines.size(), int(TerrainManager.terrain_features.size() > 0)]
steps.comment: Cleanup: restore the fixture's terrain and clear the overlay.
